answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 41 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The voyage register is checked at draw time, tide lists the eligible set, and opal seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 41 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Each impostor pays 8 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
